# Casco Achieves CREST Accreditation for Penetration Testing


Written by


[Rene Brandel](https://linkedin.com/in/renebrandel)


on


Wed Apr 08 2026


**Casco is proud to announce that we have achieved[CREST](https://www.crest-approved.org/) accreditation for penetration testing.** You can find us in the[CREST marketplace](https://marketplace.crest.org/supplier/casco/) . This accreditation recognizes our commitment to maintaining the highest standards of security testing methodology, ethics, and technical excellence.


## What is CREST?


[CREST](https://www.crest-approved.org/) (Council of Registered Ethical Security Testers) is an international not-for-profit accreditation and certification body that represents the technical information security industry. CREST accreditation is widely recognized by regulators, enterprises, and governments as a mark of quality for security testing providers.


## Why CREST Matters


CREST accreditation ensures that Casco meets rigorous standards across several dimensions:


- **Technical Competence** : Our security engineers demonstrate proven expertise through CREST examinations and ongoing professional development
- **Ethical Standards** : We adhere to a strict code of conduct governing how we handle sensitive information and conduct security assessments
- **Quality Processes** : Our penetration testing methodologies follow industry best practices with documented procedures and quality controls
- **Insurance and Liability** : CREST-accredited companies maintain appropriate professional indemnity insurance


For our clients, this means confidence that their security assessments are conducted by qualified professionals using proven methodologies.


## A Commitment to Excellence


> Casco already provides always-on security testing that outperforms traditional manual pentests. For customers who need CREST-approved penetration tests with human attestation, our Casco Supervised offering delivers the best of both worlds — expert human security engineers backed by our autonomous testing platform, all meeting the rigorous standards that CREST accreditation demands.

## Looking Ahead


This accreditation joins our existing credentials, including our OWASP AI Exchange Gold Sponsorship, reinforcing Casco's position as a trusted partner for organizations seeking comprehensive security testing. Whether you need always-on autonomous security testing or CREST-approved penetration tests with human attestation through[Casco Supervised](https://casco.com/supervised) , we deliver results backed by internationally recognized standards.
